limitations: Three manually chosen normal seeds are not a general win-rate estimate or human enjoyment test.
One normal run used four escapes and changed its main engine; it is not a pure-anxiety final clear.
Two controls are local post-hoc comparisons, not exhaustive best-play searches or campaign-wide causal estimates.
Granted defense is separate from actual body absorption.
Fire has no normal enemy source in this catalogue; resistance from expansion remains untested.
Engine and CLI test counts above are prior implementation checks; synthetic results are not included in the three normal wins.
